plan:
Final experiment design document delivered. Sections (i)–(ix) as requested:

(i) Version pin table: Python 3.12.3, numpy 1.26.4, jax 0.4.30, jaxlib 0.4.30 (CPU wheel), jaxmarl pinned to commit SHA (fallback tag v0.0.4), PettingZoo 1.24.3 (legacy) or mpe2 1.0.0 (modern); pins chosen for the bubblewrap's Python 3.12.3 and CPU-only JAX.

(ii) Environment configuration table (N=3, L=3, max_cycles=25, continuous action dim=5, Box(-1,1) — fixed horizon, no early termination) and physics-kwarg reconciliation table (dt=0.1, n_substeps=2, force_scale=1.0, damping=0.0, contact_force=1e+3, contact_margin=0.01; reconciled values passed identically to both).

(iii) Controlled vs isolated variables table: 11 rows; matched: agent count, physics kwargs, action buffer, seeds, JAX preallocation, GC, threads, affinity; isolated: action-generation RNG, t_compile, t_reset, AEC API.

(iv) Numbered timing protocol: pin_threads, warm-up (3 episodes, t_compile recorded), measurement (R=30 repeats with R=10 minimum, perf_counter_ns, gc.disable inside t0..t1, block_until_ready after every JAX step, reset outside timed region, pre-sampled action buffer).

(v) Metric battery: env-step/s, agent-step/s, per-episode wall time mean/std/min/p50/p95/max, max/min variability, 95% bootstrap CI on env-step/s, JaxMARL/PettingZoo speedup ratio with signed-log CI, t_compile separately; reporting template included.

(vi) Driver pseudocode for the shared setup, JaxMARL (with the (H,2) PRNG-key buffer pattern and block_until_ready policy), JaxMARL vmap axis, and PettingZoo parallel_env + dict-of-agents step (with action-buffer-to-dict conversion outside timed region).

(vii) Feasibility discussion tying each resolution 1–8 to a concrete design element, restating assumptions A–F, and listing risks/mitigations.

(viii) Explicit execution-prevention note: no experiment was executed, no timings were taken, and the §(v) placeholders are intentionally hollow.

(ix) Three appendices: (A) vmap K∈{1,2,4,8,16} scaling for JaxMARL only; (B) multiprocessing PettingZoo baseline as a separately-reported optional axis; (C) cross-implementation obs sanity check with explicit no-bit-identity disclaimer.

The deliverable is a single design document; no measurement was claimed and none was performed.
